response.original_title: ❖『Official-Guide』❖ How do I add a passenger on a Windstar Cruise?
response.overview: You can add a passenger to an existing Windstar Cruise booking by calling Windstar customer service directly at +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) or +44-289-708-0062 (UK), or by contacting your travel agent  Important Details to Know  No Online Options: You cannot add a passenger through the Windstar website or mobile app.  Capacity Rules: Additions depend on your stateroom's maximum capacity, overall ship occupancy, and lifeboat limits. At least one original guest must remain on the booking.  Pricing Changes: Adding a guest may cause your booking to be re-priced at current prevailing fare rates.  Required Information: Have your current booking number, the new passenger's full legal name, and their date of birth ready when you call +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) or +44-289-708-0062 (UK).
response.title: ❖『Official-Guide』❖ How do I add a passenger on a Windstar Cruise?
